messages:
Maria K: Quick sync — vendors asked about a single coordinated press window for H100/H200/B200 + MI300 + Gaudi. Do we join a combined announce or run staggered waves? Need quick input from partnerships, ops, platform, and sales.
Samir P: I lean staggered. Marketplace and discovery teams prefer 2-week gaps so listing traffic doesn't collide. Keeps embed metadata stable.
Rajesh H: From HW ops POV staggered is safer — gives us breathing room to scale images and drivers. But SI partners want a handshake window the week before public lift to validate deployment recipes.
Tina L: Platform note: canary rollout per vendor is doable, but we need ~7 business days lead for image bake + smoke tests. Also need agreed canary region.
Eugene S: Marketing/sales input: joint announcement has stronger PR, 'multi-vendor support' story sells well to enterprise. But we can get PR lift even with staggered waves if co-branded materials are ready.
Maria K: Proposed approach: "cooperative press gating" — single embargo signing (vendors + Redwood) followed by staggered public lifts (wave 0 / +7d / +14d). SI handshake happens in pre-embargo window. Thoughts?
Rajesh H: That matches ops constraints. Request: provide SI partners with a 3-day pre-embargo lab window and a kernel/tag checklist. Also want explicit inventory for test nodes per vendor.
Samir P: Sounds good. I'll sketch a minimal release spec. Drop a calendar/template so vendors see the cadence.
Samir P: ```
release_waves:
  embargo_date: 2026-04-15T16:00Z
  wave_1_public: +0d
  wave_2_public: +7d
  wave_3_public: +14d
  si_handover: -3d
  canary_region: us-west-2
  exception_flow: legal-signoff
```
Maria K: Nice. Action items (short):
- Rajesh: confirm lab capacity and node counts by EOD Tue
- Tina: prepare canary playbook + image tag checklist
- Eugene: align with vendor PR leads on co-branding and exception flow
- Samir: create calendar invites + embargo doc and circulate
Rajesh H: Confirm lab capacity: reserving 8 B200/H200 nodes, 4 H100, 6 MI300, 6 Gaudi for pre-embargo testing. Will publish the asset inventory to the team.
Tina L: Canary playbook draft up: http://tiny.redwood/canary-playbook (placeholder). Will open PR with smoke test steps and rollback criteria.
Maria K: @embargo-bot can you create an embargo doc template and ping vendor leads so legal + marketing can review?
embargo-bot: embargo-bot: Template created at /docs/embargo-template.md. Pinged @Maria K @Samir P.
Eugene S: One vendor marketing ask: allow an embargo exception for partner case studies (they need to publish on short notice). We should define an exception flow with legal pre-approval.
Maria K: Agreed — add legal signoff step to the exception flow. Samir, can you add that to the YAML and the calendar invite?
Samir P: Done. I updated the spec and will circulate the invite for Thu 30m. Also attaching the checklist in that invite.
Maria K: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the invites. If anything urgent, DM me (I can triage vendor escalations).
